title: Testing Local LLMs on tsrazer
text:
This Machine: Razer Blade 18 (2026 loaner)
OS: - Ubuntu 26.04 LTS – Dual boot with Windows 11

I have to reconfigure these machines for straight up Ubuntu because Windows and WSL2 eats about eight gigabytes of system RAM, which maybe isn’t that big a deal on this machine, but also you get a lot of system instability, and the thing will lock up and freeze. I got tired of it. Ubuntu is rock solid.

GPU: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 Laptop GPU
Memory: 64 GB RAM – yea, it’s nice
VRAM: 24 GB VRAM
Local LLM Findings: Qwen3 14B runs comfortably Qwen3.6 27B runs surprisingly well ~17–19 GB VRAM usage for Qwen3.6:27B Qwen3 32B appears to hit memory-pressure territory
